title.official: Digital Economy Agreement between the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland and the Republic of Singapore

relevance.reason: A bilateral digital-economy agreement containing a dedicated AI and emerging-technologies article. The AI provision is cooperative and best-efforts, but it expressly addresses AI governance, algorithmic transparency and bias.
ai_provisions: Article 8.61-R — AI and emerging technologies: domestic governance and policy frameworks, international principles, cooperation on AI challenges including human diversity and unintended biases, technical standards and algorithmic transparency
relevance.excluded_scope: The AI article does not create substantive market-access rules, prohibitions or enforcement obligations.

dates.notes: Signed in Singapore on 25 February 2022; entered into force on 14 June 2022.

status_note: In force between the United Kingdom and Singapore.
